failure_conditions: interfaces cannot preserve non-AI service parity
affected groups cannot pause or appeal
official spatial or ownership evidence invalidates placement
operations reserve and qualified human review are unavailable

replay_contract.method_note: The runner independently derives policy controls from explicit synthetic payloads, checks counterfactuals, canonical hashes, energy envelopes and audit fields, and fails closed on any mismatch.

cohorts: older and disabled users with chosen supporters
residents and caregivers including a child-safeguarding observer
small merchants and frontline service workers
developers, students and visitors using both Chinese and English paths
prerequisites: accessible route and staffed non-AI desk
informed consent and independent affected-group steward
privacy, insurance, safeguarding and emergency plan

pre_registered_measures.threshold: non-AI completion no worse than 10 percentage points below the digital route
median non-AI wait no more than 1.20 times the digital wait and never more than 5 additional minutes
no extra fee and no extra off-site trip for refusing AI
keyboard, screen-reader, seated, tactile/paper and bilingual paths complete without critical barrier
appeal receipt succeeds and any steward red card places the interface on hold before the next public session

field_validation_plan.publication_rule: Publish anonymized method, failures, non-adoption reasons and retirement decision; never label these measures passed until an authorized field session produces independently reviewed evidence.
